name: Plum Blossoms and Bamboo
dimensions: painting proper: H. 40 × W. 35.4 cm (15 3/4 × 13 15/16 in.)
summary: Signed in ink as by Yang Buzhi (sobriquet of Song artist Yang Wujiu, 1097-1171) and a seal reading "Yang Buzhi yin"; and collectors' seals of Shi Minggu and Xiang Yuanbian (1525-1590).
